research.angle: Flashbulb memories are characterized by high confidence and vividness rather than superior accuracy, as their consistency declines over time just like everyday memories.
research.verdict: The evidence shows that while flashbulb memories feel more accurate and vivid than everyday memories, they do not actually maintain higher levels of consistency over time.
research.caveat: The studies often rely on self-reported ratings of confidence and vividness rather than objective measures of factual accuracy.
